The SANRECO Phase 2 trial completed patient dosing in June 2026 and topline results are anticipated in August 2026.
AstraZeneca shared interim results from its Phase 1 randomized, single-blind, placebo-controlled trial assessing SLN312 in 98 patients with dyslipidemia.
Interim results showed SLN312 produced durable dose-dependent reductions in ANGPTL3, triglycerides and atherogenic lipoproteins after single and multiple doses.
